name: Pass (Teamwork)
body:
You are adept at using your allies as aids in your throws.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (aqua ball)

While an ally with this feat is within 15 feet and line of sight and effect, you may treat them as the origin point of any attacks made with an aqua ball, determining range from their allies’ positions instead of your own.
